name: Answered in a chat
title: Answered in a chat: a question waiting in Decisions that you already answered in a chat, with your words, to answer it in one press

events.answered_with_that: You pressed Answer with that under a waiting question you had already answered in a chat

runs.answer_found: Rouh found where you already answered a waiting question in a chat

permissions: reads your own messages in your chats since a question was asked, to see whether one answers it
answers a question only when you press Answer with that, the usual way, with its undo
jobs: a reading every minute of the questions a new message of yours is about, one model call each (Models, Questions you already answered in a chat)
